root_text: @WellSpan Are you requiring or recommending masks as UPMC is? Have you seen HMPV?

nodes.author: KarenStrine3
nodes.text: @WellSpan Are you requiring or recommending masks as UPMC is? Have you seen HMPV?

nodes.author: WellSpan
nodes.text: @KarenStrine3 Hi Karen, Thank you for your question. We are committed to keeping our patients, visitors, and staff as healthy and safe as possible. You can review WellSpan's current mask policy on our website, linked here: https://t.co/lhXFC4hAVW Thank you.

nodes.author: KarenStrine3
nodes.text: @WellSpan Hello, I got a response during  last year’s Covid surge that wearing a mask was about patient’s comfort. I saved it. If this worked, there’d be more masks per wastewater data, of people wearing masks for 10 days. Few are testing & I don’t know of anyone who has followed that.

nodes.author: KarenStrine3
nodes.text: @WellSpan Does WellSpan have improved ventilation or farUVC in any facilities? Do you allow patients to bring HEPAs after the biomedical dept does a safety check of them?

nodes.author: WellSpan
nodes.text: @KarenStrine3 Thank you for your question, Karen. Please contact the WellSpan CareLine for help addressing specific questions related to patient care by calling 877- 232-5807. You can also contact them online: https://t.co/Ga07X2wT0T Thank you.

nodes.author: KarenStrine3
nodes.text: @WellSpan Thank you. That’s who I did contact last year when a family member got sick after testing.
